headline: Bears Legend Mike Ditka Passes Away At 86
summary: The National Football League, the Bears franchise, and the city of Chicago have lost an icon. headline: Ravens’ Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens To Miss Week 5
summary: The sprained ankle Lamar Jackson suffered in Week 4 will sideline the superstar quarterback for at least one game. headline: Chargers LT Rashawn Slater on IR following ankle surgery
summary: The Chargers are placing Rashawn Slater on injured reserve after the left tackle had surgery for a high ankle sprain. Los Angeles will be without three of its starting offensive linemen against the Broncos on Sunday.

headline: Rams DT Aaron Donald practices in full, plans to play MNF
summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald practiced in full Friday and said he plans to play Monday night against the Bills after missing Week 4 with back soreness.
